header.description: XP, levels and reward roles in {guild}: members level up by interacting and get roles automatically.

errors.minAboveMax: Minimum XP can't be higher than the maximum.

enabled.label: Module enabled
enabled.description: When off, members stop earning XP (history is kept).

perMessage.label: XP per message
perMessage.description: Each message grants a random amount in this range (default 15 to 25, same as MEE6).

cooldown.label: Cooldown between messages (seconds)
cooldown.description: Anti-spam: messages within the cooldown don't count. Default 60s.

voice.label: Voice XP
voice.description: Grants XP per minute in a call (not AFK, not muted, with other people).
voice.perMinute: XP per minute in a call

curve.label: XP curve
curve.description: Multiplies the cost of each level (1.0 = default curve). Above 1 makes leveling slower; below, faster.

errors.channelRequired: Choose the fixed channel for the level-up message.

destination.label: Where to notify
destination.description: Where the bot sends the message when a member levels up.

template.label: Message (optional)
template.emptyHint: Empty = the bot uses a default message.
template.proEditor: Block-based Embed editor (MessageDesign V2) comes with Pro.

errors.roleRequired: Choose the role for each multiplier.
errors.positive: Each multiplier must be greater than zero.
errors.duplicate: A role is repeated, only one multiplier per role.

multipliers.title: Multiplier per role
multipliers.description: Members with the role earn multiplied XP. The {highest} applicable one always wins (2× and 3× roles = 3×, not 6×). XP blocks take precedence.
multipliers.unavailable: Multipliers are coming soon. You can already build the list; saving is enabled once the feature arrives.

roles.label: Roles without XP
roles.description: Members with any of these roles don't earn XP.

channels.label: Channels without XP
channels.description: Messages in these channels don't earn XP (e.g. commands, spam, off-topic).

ignoreBots.label: Ignore bots
ignoreBots.description: Bots don't earn XP even if they send messages.

ranking.noData: No XP data for this member.
ranking.unavailable: The web leaderboard is coming soon.

errors.invalidLevel: Each reward needs a valid level (≥ 1).
errors.roleRequired: Choose the role for each reward.
errors.duplicate: Level {level} is repeated, only one role per level.

mode.label: Grant mode
mode.description: {stack}: keeps every role earned. {highest}: on level-up, removes the previous level's role.

list.label: Roles per level
list.description: The member gets the role on reaching the level.

rewards.unavailable: Reward roles are coming soon. You can already build the list; saving is enabled once the feature arrives.

adjust.label: Manual XP adjustment
adjust.description: Gives, removes or sets a member's XP. It can trigger a level-up.

reset.label: XP reset
reset.description: Clears XP. Doesn't touch settings, reward roles or multipliers.

resetMember.label: Reset one member
resetMember.confirmDescription: Clears all of this member's XP and level. This can't be undone.

resetGuild.confirmTitle: Reset XP for the ENTIRE server?
resetGuild.confirmDescription: Clears XP and level for every member. Reward roles, multipliers and settings are kept. This action is irreversible.
resetGuild.secondDescription: Final confirmation: all XP progress on the server will be erased.
